user_problem: Two supplied inventory counts disagree and require a controlled review plan without changing records.
unique_output: A reconciliation worksheet grouping exact matches, explainable differences, recount candidates, and unresolved discrepancies.
required_input: Two count lists, item identifiers, documented adjustments, count times, and permitted resolution steps.
critical_rule: Never alter a count or assume shrinkage; retain both observations and cite any adjustment used.
nearest_existing_and_difference: Nearest is duplicate-record-triage; this reconciles count discrepancies rather than classifying record similarity.
acceptance_scenario: Input morning count X=10, evening X=8, documented sale of 2; Y is 5 versus 3 with no adjustment. Output explains X arithmetically and marks Y for recount without changing either value.
